_doc: Account-specific values for every package in this sample. Each package reads this file through its settings.py (found one directory above the package); nothing else in the code names an account, bucket, queue or secret. Replace every <placeholder>; a placeholder that is still in place fails loudly at the first AWS call that needs it.

aws._doc: region for every AWS client; profile for local runs (null = default credential chain, always null inside containers); account_id only for composing ECR URIs.

s3._doc: data_bucket holds minute panels, peers, constituent snapshots, press releases and every study result; diagnostics_bucket holds event universes and ad-hoc diagnostics (may be the same bucket).

redshift._doc: Redshift Serverless workgroup carrying the FactSet corporate-events datashare (AWS Data Exchange), queried through the redshift-data API with a Secrets Manager admin secret.

secrets._doc: Secrets Manager secret names for the market-data vendor API keys (alpaca: JSON {key_id, secret_key}; databento: JSON {api_key}).

batch._doc: job_queue: the shared CPU queue for evaluation arrays; alpaca_job_queue: a queue capped at ~24 vCPUs so Alpaca rate limits hold; compute_environment: only used by the hand-provisioning infra scripts; job_definitions: one per package, provisioned by the infrastructure stack.

paths._doc: constituent_cache_dir: where the index-constituent fetch scripts keep their per-index cache manifests, relative to this file.

codebuild._doc: CodeBuild projects that build each package's container image from the source zip (used by the internal packaging scripts only).
